Class SpatialHash

Namespace
ShapeEngine.Geometry.CollisionSystem
Assembly
ShapeEngine.dll

Implements a spatial hash grid for efficient broad-phase collision detection and spatial queries.

public class SpatialHash : IBounds

Remarks

The spatial hash divides a 2D space into a grid of buckets, each containing colliders that overlap its region. Provides fast lookup for collision candidates and supports dynamic resizing and grid changes.

rows int

The new number of rows.

Remarks

Recalculates spacing, clears and removes all old buckets, and then creates new buckets according to rows*cols.

Close()

Clears all buckets and internal registers, releasing resources.
